newsitem.title: USA: Signal sees improvement in Q3, Q4.
newsitem.headline: Signal sees improvement in Q3, Q4.

text.p: Signal Technology Corp said Thursday it expects to regain positive momentum through the third and fourth quarter and remains committed to pursuing acquisition targets.
The company said the fourth quarter is typically its best quarter. It also said it will pursue acquisitions that complement its core businesses.

Earlier, the company reported a loss per share for the second quarter of $0.01 compared to a profit of $0.02 per share. Sales for the quarter fell slightly, to $25.5 million from $27.4 million for the second quarter of 1996.

The company said lower-than-expected shipments from its Arizona and Keltec operations contributed to the loss. But it said it has made adjustments to improve efficiency at the facilities and believes the temporary difficulties were part of a management transition.

Signal makes electronic components for defense, space and communications applications, including communications networks, satellite communications, electronic countermeasures, intelligence and guidance systems.
